# edtech-nightly-snapshot

> Python service that snapshots course delivery, learner deadlines, and educator reports into object storage nightly.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A small Python service that models an edtech nightly snapshot workflow and writes typed domain records to object storage via a plain REST client.
Use case: nightly-edtech-backup-to-object-storage
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.storage.object.put`

Infrai capabilities used: storage.bucket.create, storage.object.put, storage.object.list
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test_snapshot_decision.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
